get.summary: Lists every account on the shard.
get.description: Passwords are never returned, by any account route.

post.description:
Username and password are required, and the username must be free — a taken one answers 409. Level
is optional and defaults to Player; when sent it must name an account level, case-insensitively.
A 503 means the game loop did not respond and the account was not created.

get.summary: Fetches a single account by username.
get.description: Answers 404 when no account carries that username.

patch.summary: Updates an account, changing only the fields that are sent.
patch.description:
Every field is optional; an omitted one is left as it is. Answers 404 for an unknown account, and
400 when the level does not name one. Returns the account as it stands after the update. A 503
means the game loop did not respond and the account was not updated.

delete.summary: Deletes an account, along with its characters and everything they carry.
delete.description:
Permanent, and the only account route that changes the world rather than just the account record.
An account whose character is currently being played cannot be deleted: the request answers 409
until that character logs out. A 503 means the game loop did not respond and nothing was deleted.

get.summary: Reports the shard's name, build and how many sessions are connected.
get.description: A snapshot taken when the request is served, not a live figure.

get.summary: Lists the plugins this shard activated, each with the HTTP routes it declares.
get.description:
Routes belonging to no plugin — the API reference and framework middleware — are gathered under a
final synthetic entry with id `moongate.host`, so that everything the shard serves appears
somewhere. `policy` names the authorization policy guarding a route, and is null when the
route is open.

post.summary: Trades account credentials for a bearer token.
post.description:
The token carries the account's username and level, and every other route reads authorisation from
it. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Any failure answers 401 without saying
which part was wrong.

post.summary: Exchanges a still-valid token for a fresh one, so an active session does not expire mid-use.
post.description:
Send the current token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; the reply has the same shape as
`/api/v1/auth/login`. The new token keeps the `auth_time` of the one presented, so renewing
never restarts the session: past `http.Jwt.MaxSessionHours` from the original login the answer is
401 and the user must sign in again. A 401 also means the account has been deactivated.

get.summary: Every player character on the shard, paged.
get.description:
Ordered by character name. Pass search to filter: it is free text, case-insensitive, and matches
either the character's name or the owning account's username, so "find me so-and-so's character" is
one query. Page is 1-based and defaults to 1; pageSize defaults to 25 and cannot exceed 100. NPCs
are not characters and never appear. A search matching nothing is an empty page, not an error.

get.summary: One character in full: stats, appearance, what they wear and what they carry.
get.description:
The serial takes the form the rest of the API reports, `0x40000001`, or plain decimal. An
account may read its own characters; staff may read anyone's, and everyone else gets 403. A
serial naming no character is 404, and so is one that is not a number.
- The backpack is a tree: nested containers are expanded, to a depth of 10. Equipment lists
the worn items by layer, the backpack and the bank box among them, without expanding them.
- Skills are the ones the character has, by name, in points rather than the tenths the entity
stores.
- Read off the game loop, so an item the loop moves mid-read may appear in neither place or
in both. The next request settles it: this is a view, not a ledger.

get.summary: What the game says about one item the character is carrying or wearing.
get.description:
The lines are the object property list the game client renders, resolved to text — the item's
name, its weight, and whatever else the shard describes. A shard whose string table is not
loaded gets an **empty** list rather than an error: the technical fields are still worth having.
- The route is nested under the character because an item knows its container, not whose it
is. Authorization is the character's — an account reads its own, staff read anyone's — and the
item must actually be in that character's equipment or backpack, so a serial cannot be probed.
- Answers 503 when the game loop does not respond: the property list is built on the loop,
whose cache is deliberately unsynchronized.

get.summary: Opens a per-connection SSE feed; its first event carries the connection id to POST with.
get.description:
Emits `ready` (data = the connection id), then a `line` per command reply and a
`done` when a command finishes. The connection is closed when the client disconnects.

post.summary: Runs a console command; its reply lines stream to the given connection's SSE feed.
post.description:
Returns 202 immediately — the command is dispatched onto the game loop and its output
arrives asynchronously on `GET /api/v1/admin/console/stream`.

get.summary: Every hue the client files describe, paged.
get.description:
Values are 1-based, the way packets and the image routes take them: hue 1 is the first row of
hues.mul and hue 0 means unhued, so 0 is not listed. Each row carries a representative colour for
a swatch and eight evenly spaced steps of the full ramp. Search matches the number or the name.
Without client files the catalogue is empty rather than an error, because a shard can run
headless — the hue table exists either way, but its unread entries paint nothing and are left
out.

get.summary: Every item tile the client files describe, paged.
get.description:
Rows carry the tile's flags, weight and height, and the URL of its art. Search matches the
decimal id, the 0x-prefixed hex, or the tiledata name. Pass flag to keep only tiles carrying one
— Container, Wearable, Weapon and the rest of TileFlagType — and an unknown flag name is a 400
rather than a silently unfiltered list. Nameless tiles are the unused ids and are listed too,
because their graphic may still be worth picking. Without client files the catalogue is empty
rather than an error, because a shard can run headless.

get.summary: Item art as a PNG, optionally hued.
get.description:
Open without a token: the art is client data every player already has on disk. The id is hex, with
or without the 0x prefix — 0x1234.png and 1234.png are the same item. Pass hue for a coloured
variant; 0, or omitting it, gives the raw art, and the range is 0 to 3000. Images are decoded on
first request and cached, so the first call for an item is slower than every call after it.

get.summary: The facets this shard serves, and the shape of each one's tile grid.
get.description:
Open without a token. Read this before requesting tiles: the facets' sizes come from the shard's own
client files, so maxZoom and the grid differ between shards and must not be hardcoded.

get.summary: A whole facet as one PNG.
get.description:
Open without a token. The entire facet at one pixel per map tile — 6144×4096 for Felucca — for
downloading or printing rather than browsing; use the tiles for a viewer. Optional `?style=`
picks `flat` (default) or `relief` as on the tile route. It is generated once and
cached, and the first request is slow and memory-hungry if the staff pre-warm has not run.

get.summary: One map tile.
get.description:
Open without a token: map data is client data every player already has on disk. The facet is named,
case-insensitively — felucca, trammel, ilshenar, malas, tokuno, termur. Zoom counts up to detail: 0
is the whole facet in one tile, and maxZoom — which GET /api/v1/images/maps reports per facet — is
one pixel per map tile. Tiles are 256×256. A tile at the facet's edge is padded transparent. Tiles
are rendered on first request and cached, so the first call at a low zoom builds everything beneath
it and is slow; the staff pre-warm exists to do that in advance. Optional `?style=` chooses the
render: `flat` (default) is the radar map, `relief` adds altitude shading; each caches on
its own.

post.summary: Builds every map tile and whole-facet image into the cache.
post.description:
Answers 202 and works in the background; poll this same route with GET for progress. Only one runs
at a time, so a second request while one is going answers 409. Worth running before anyone opens a
viewer: the first request at a low zoom otherwise builds every tile beneath it, and the first
request for a whole facet renders a facet-sized image. Progress is kept in memory and does not
survive a restart.

get.summary: Reports how far the map image export has got.
get.description:
State is Idle before any export has run, then Running, and finally Completed or Failed. Failed counts
images that could not be produced; the reasons are in the server log.

post.summary: Generates every item's art into the cache.
post.description:
Answers 202 and works in the background; poll this same route with GET for progress. Only one
export runs at a time, so a second request while one is going answers 409. Unhued art only — hued
variants are generated on demand by the public image route. Progress is kept in memory and does
not survive a restart.

get.summary: Reports how far the item image export has got.
get.description:
State is Idle before any export has run, then Running, and finally Completed or Failed. Failed
counts items whose art could not be written; the reasons are in the server log.

get.summary: Every item template, paged.
get.description:
Ordered by template id. Pass search to filter: free text, case-insensitive, matching the
template's id, name, the client's name for its graphic, category or any tag. Page is 1-based
and defaults to 1; pageSize defaults to 25 and cannot exceed 100. A search matching nothing
is an empty page, not an error.

get.summary: Fetches one item template by id, specs included.
get.description: Ids are case-insensitive. Answers 404 when no template carries the id.

get.summary: Serves a body's idle, front-facing frame as PNG.
get.description:
The body is a decimal graphic id; pass hue for a skin-hued variant. Generated lazily and cached
on disk. A body with no usable animation answers 404. Anonymous on purpose: it is client data
every player already has on disk.

get.summary: Serves a hair (or facial-hair) style as PNG, rendered over a reference body.
get.description:
The style is the hair item's decimal graphic id (see /api/v1/admin/hair-styles). Pass hue to dye
it, body to change the reference body (default 400, the human male), facial=true for beards.
404 when nothing decodes for the pair.

get.summary: Serves a mobile template's dressed figure as PNG: body, hair and worn equipment.
get.description:
Hue specs on the template resolve to their low end so the image is stable and cacheable. 404 on
an unknown template id, or when the template's body has no animation.

get.summary: Every classified body, paged, for the picker.
get.description:
Classification comes from mobtypes.txt; Equipment-type bodies never appear. Search matches the
decimal id or the 0x-prefixed hex. Ordered by body id.

get.summary: The selectable hair (or facial-hair) styles, paged.
get.description: Pass facial=true for beards. Search matches the style name, case-insensitively.

get.summary: Serves the template's classic client paperdoll as PNG: background, body, hair, equipment.
get.description:
Pass background=false to drop the backdrop gump. Hue and gender-random specs on the template
resolve deterministically so the image is stable and cacheable. 404 on an unknown template id or
when its body has no paperdoll gump.

get.summary: Serves a character's dressed figure as PNG: body, hair and the items they are wearing.
get.description:
The serial takes the form the rest of the API reports, `0x40000001`, or plain decimal.
The ETag is a fingerprint of the appearance, so a client that already has the current look gets
304 without a body. 404 when the serial names no mobile, or when its body has no animation.

get.summary: Serves a character's paperdoll as PNG, with the equipment they are wearing.
get.description:
The serial takes the form the rest of the API reports, `0x40000001`, or plain decimal.
Pass `background=false` for the doll without its backdrop. The ETag is a fingerprint of
the appearance, so an unchanged character gets 304 without a body.

get.summary: Every mobile template, paged.
get.description:
Ordered by template id. Pass search to filter: free text, case-insensitive, matching the
template's id, name, title, category or any tag. Page is 1-based and defaults to 1; pageSize
defaults to 25 and cannot exceed 100. A search matching nothing is an empty page, not an error.
            
A template's hues are reported as the specs they are — a value or a range resolved per spawn —
rather than as numbers.

get.summary: Fetches one mobile template by id, variants and equipment included.
get.description: Ids are case-insensitive. Answers 404 when no template carries the id.

post.summary: Generates every classified body's image into the cache.
post.description:
Answers 202 and works in the background; poll this same route with GET for progress. Only one
export runs at a time, so a second request while one is going answers 409. Unhued frames only —
hued variants are generated on demand by the public image route.

get.summary: Reports how far the body image export has got.
get.description: State is Idle before any export has run, then Running, and finally Completed or Failed.

post.summary: Creates a news entry, authored by the calling staff member.

get.summary: Lists every news entry, drafts included, newest first.
Returns one news entry in any state.

put.summary: Updates a news entry's title, body and published state.

get.summary: Lists published news, newest first.
Returns one published news entry; 404 if it is missing or a draft.
Reports the account the bearer token belongs to.
get.description:
Username and level, read straight from the token — useful for confirming a token is still valid
and what it grants. It does not list the account's characters.

get.summary: The caller's own characters.
get.description:
Reports every character on the account the bearer token belongs to, with its stats, appearance and
where it stands. Never another account's. The owner field is null here: the caller is the owner. An
account with no characters gets an empty list, not an error.

get.summary: Lists players who have entered the world with map-ready positions.
get.description:
Staff only. The response is an unpaged snapshot ordered by character name and serial. Login and
character-selection sessions are excluded. The snapshot is read directly while the game loop may
move or disconnect a player, so one response can be briefly stale or internally inconsistent.

post.summary: Registers a new account when web registration is open.
post.description:
Answers 403 when registration is disabled, 429 when the caller is rate-limited, 409 for a taken
username, 400 for a missing or malformed field, and 202 on success — the account is created
inactive and must verify its email before it can log in.

post.summary: Verifies an account's email with its token, activating the account.
post.description: Answers 410 for an expired token and 400 for an unknown or already-used token.

post.summary: Resends the verification message for a matching pending public registration.
post.description:
Answers 202 whether or not the supplied identity matches a pending account, so callers cannot
discover registered usernames or email addresses.

get.summary: Returns the shard's public profile: name, description, contacts, asset URLs and whether registration is open.
Streams a visual asset (logo, favicon or banner) by slot.
get.description: Answers 400 for an unknown slot and 404 when the slot has no asset.

get.summary: Returns the full server settings.

put.summary: Updates the server settings; every field is optional and an omitted one is left unchanged.

post.summary: Uploads the image for a slot (logo, favicon or banner), replacing any previous one.
post.description: Answers 400 for an unknown slot, 415 for a non-image type, and 413 when the file is too large.

delete.summary: Removes the image for a slot.

get.summary: Reports the shard's public statistics: players online, accounts, world size and loaded content.
Reports the shard's name and build.
get.description: Open without a token, so a launcher or the website can check compatibility before anyone logs in.

AccountResponse.description:
An account as the API reports it. Deliberately not `AccountEntity`, which carries PasswordHash
and ActivationToken: returning the entity would publish both to every caller, log and proxy cache on
the way. Naming the fields here means a field added to the entity later cannot leak by default.

AdminStatusResponse.description: A staff-level snapshot of the shard. No uptime: there is no "shard started at" to read.

ApiTokenResult.description: An issued API token and the moment it stops being valid.

total.description: Classified, non-equipment bodies to process. 0 until the export has counted them.

failed.description: Bodies whose frame could not be rendered or written. The reasons are in the log.

startedAt.description: When the current or last export started; null if none ever has.

BodyImageExportStatus.description: How far the bulk body-image export has got.

BodySummary.description: One row of the staff body picker.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

BodySummaryPagedResponse.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

equipment.description: Worn items by layer, the backpack and the bank box among them.

backpack.description: The backpack's contents, nested containers expanded.

skills.description:
The skills the character has, by name. Sparse on purpose: a mobile never stores a skill left at
zero, so this is what the character actually trained rather than the whole catalogue.

CharacterDetailResponse.description: Everything one character is: who they are, what they wear, what they carry.

name.description: The item's name. Blank when the item is named by cliloc rather than stored text.

templateId.description: The template it was built from.

layer.description: The layer it is worn on, or null when it sits inside a container.

contents.description: What it contains. Empty for anything that is not a container.

CharacterItemResponse.description:
One item as the API reports it, with whatever it contains. Deliberately not `ItemEntity`, which
carries script and loot ids: a field added to the entity later would publish itself.

accountUsername.description: The owning account. Null on the player's own route, where it is the caller.

CharacterResponse.description:
A character as the API reports it. Deliberately not `MobileEntity`, which carries BrainScriptId,
LootTableId and BackpackId: returning the entity would publish the shard's internals to every caller,
and a field added to the entity later would publish itself. Naming the fields here means that cannot
happen by default — the same reason Moongate.Http.Plugin.Data.Api.Accounts.AccountResponse exists rather than returning
AccountEntity with its PasswordHash.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

CharacterResponsePagedResponse.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

id.description: The skill id, which is what the mobile stores it under.

name.description: The skill's name, or its id when no definition is registered for it.

value.description:
The skill's value in points — 50.0, not the 500 tenths the entity stores. The tenths are a storage
detail, and reporting them would leave every consumer to remember to divide.

cap.description: That skill's personal ceiling, in points. 100.0 unless something raised it.

lock.description:
Whether the skill may drift as it is used: `Up`, `Down` or `Locked` — the arrow the
client shows beside each entry.

CharacterSkillResponse.description: One skill a character has, as the API reports it.

ConsoleCommandRequest.description: A console command to run and the SSE connection its output should stream to.

CreateAccountRequest.description:
A new account. `Level` is the `AccountLevelType` name; omitted means Player, the safe
default — an account that gains staff rights by accident is the wrong way to fail.

CreateNewsRequest.description: Body for creating a news entry; the author is taken from the caller's token.

HairStyleSummary.description: One row of the staff hair-style picker.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

HairStyleSummaryPagedResponse.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

HueSummary.description: One row of the hue catalogue: what to call a hue, and what it looks like.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

HueSummaryPagedResponse.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

total.description: Items with art to export. 0 until the export has counted them.

failed.description: Items whose art could not be written. The reasons are in the log.

startedAt.description: When the current or last export started; null if none ever has.

ItemImageExportStatus.description: How far the bulk item-image export has got.

ItemTemplateResponse.description:
The full template: everything the summary carries plus the typed specs, passed through as the
Moongate.UO.Data types — they are the documented data contract of the YAML templates.

ItemTemplateSummaryResponse.description: One row of the staff item template listing.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

ItemTemplateSummaryResponsePagedResponse.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

lines.description:
The object property list as the game client renders it, resolved to text. Empty when the shard's
string table is not loaded — the technical fields are still worth showing, so that is not an error.

templateId.description: The template it was built from.

ItemTooltipResponse.description: What the game itself says about one item, plus what the portal knows about it.

LoginRequest.description: Credentials posted to the login endpoint.

name.description: The facet's name, as used in the tile route.

width.description: Facet width in map tiles, which is its width in pixels at native zoom.

maxZoom.description: The deepest zoom, where one pixel is one map tile. Zoom 0 is always one tile.

tilesAcross.description: Tiles across the grid at MaxZoom.

tilesDown.description: Tiles down the grid at MaxZoom.

MapFacetInfo.description: A map facet as the API describes it, so a viewer can configure itself rather than guess.

done.description: Tiles and whole-facet images produced so far.

total.description: How many there are to produce. 0 until the pre-warm has counted them.

failed.description: How many could not be produced. The reasons are in the log.

startedAt.description: When the current or last pre-warm started; null if none ever has.

MapImageExportStatus.description: How far the map image pre-warm has got.

skinHue.description: A hue spec, not a number: a single value or a range like `0x455-0x45a` resolved once per spawn. Reported as written, because picking one end of a range would lie about the other.

MobileAppearanceResponse.description: How a template says a mobile looks, shared by the template and each of its variants.

item.description: The item template id to spawn.

hue.description: A hue spec, or null to leave the item its own colour.

MobileEquipmentResponse.description: One item a template spawns its mobile wearing.

namePool.description: The pool a spawn draws its name from when the template has no fixed one.

gender.description: The gender name, or null when the template lets a spawn pick.

baseMobile.description: The template this one merges over, or null when it stands alone.

skills.description: Skill values by name, as the template sets them.

variants.description: Weighted alternatives, each with its own appearance and equipment.

MobileTemplateResponse.description: One mobile spawn template in full.

body.description: The animation body id, which is what the picture is drawn from.

variantCount.description: How many weighted alternatives the template carries.

MobileTemplateSummaryResponse.description: One row of the staff mobile template listing.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

MobileTemplateSummaryResponsePagedRespon.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

weight.description: Its share of the draw, relative to the other variants.

gender.description: The gender name, or null when the variant does not fix one.

MobileVariantResponse.description: One variant of a template: a weighted alternative look, name pool and loot.

NewsResponse.description: A news entry as returned by the API.

characterSerial.description: Stable character serial, formatted as hexadecimal.

accountSerial.description: Owning account serial, formatted as hexadecimal.

mapName.description: Known facet name, or Unknown for an unrecognised id.

direction.description: Facing direction without the running flag.

running.description: Whether the latest direction carries the running flag.

warmode.description: Whether the character is in war mode.

OnlinePlayerMapResponse.description: A map-ready snapshot of one player currently in the world.

PlayerMeResponse.description: Who the caller's token says they are. Deliberately not their characters — see PlayerEndpoints.

PluginInfoResponse.description:
One activated plugin and everything it exposes over HTTP. `version` goes over the wire as a
string, e.g. `"0.1.0"`.

PluginRouteResponse.description: One HTTP route a plugin declares. `policy` is null when the route is open.

RegistrationReadinessResponse.description: The local prerequisites behind public account registration availability.

ResendVerificationRequest.description: Identifies a pending public registration for a verification-message resend.

ServerInfoResponse.description:
The public server profile a website or launcher reads: identity, contacts, assets, and effective registration
availability.

ServerSettingsResponse.description: The full settings view returned to staff, including persisted registration state and readiness.

ServerStatsResponse.description: The shard's public statistics, as a website or launcher reads them.

StatsAccountsResponse.description: The shard's user base: accounts registered, accounts verified, and characters created.

StatsContentResponse.description: How much content the shard has loaded: the templates available to spawn from.

StatsPlayersResponse.description: Who is connected: players in the world, and every open connection including the login screen.

StatsWorldResponse.description: How much the world holds: creatures nobody plays, and persisted items.

UoItemSummary.description:
One row of the raw item catalogue: a tile as the client files describe it, before any template has
had an opinion about it.

total.description: How many results matched in total, before paging.

pageSize.description: The page size used. The last page may hold fewer items.

totalPages.description: How many pages exist at this page size. 0 when nothing matched.

UoItemSummaryPagedResponse.description: One page of results, and what a caller needs to walk the rest.

UpdateAccountRequest.description:
The fields to change. Every one is optional: absent means "leave alone", which is what makes this a
PATCH rather than a PUT. Password is write-only — it enters here and never appears in a response.
Email is not here: the account service has no setter for it.

UpdateNewsRequest.description: Body for updating a news entry.

UpdateServerSettingsRequest.description: A partial settings update: an omitted (null) field is left unchanged.

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Carries the single-use token that verifies an account's email.

VersionResponse.description: What the shard calls itself and which build it runs.
